# OpenRouter Connector for Muse

A Muse agent skill with read-only access to OpenRouter: browse the full model catalog with per-token pricing, and check your API key's label, usage, and limit. No chat-completion or key-management commands ship — it never runs models and never spends your credits. Uses an OpenRouter API key (openrouter.ai/keys), kept in Muse's secure vault. Draft: written from OpenRouter's public API docs, not yet live-tested end-to-end — this listing's unverified status reflects that. No secrets in the repo.
